Demystifying Finance: Crafting the UX for Aditya Birla Capital Credit Score Tool

ClientAditya Birla Capital
DisciplinesUX Design
IndustryFintech
Timeline2022

About

Aditya Birla Capital, in partnership with Experian, undertook a project to develop a consumer-facing digital tool for instant credit score checking and comprehensive financial literacy. The platform was designed to transform the traditionally complex process of credit reporting into an accessible, confidence-inspiring consumer journey.

Challenges

Trust and Transparency

The UX needed to establish immediate credibility, given the high-stakes nature and sensitivity of personal credit scores and financial data.

Translating Technical Complexity

The primary hurdle was simplifying the intricate logic of a credit report (score factors, debt loads) into easily digestible, actionable language for the average user.

Seamless Integration

Ensuring that the design seamlessly integrated the complex, raw technical data provided by Experian into a clean, easy-to-understand consumer format.

Solutions

Intuitive Multi-Step Guided Flow

Designed a clear, multi-screen input process for data submission to minimize user confusion and drop-off, complete with best-in-class error handling.

Visual Trustworthy Score Presentation

The final credit score was prominently displayed with a clean, high-trust visual hierarchy, providing users with their key information immediately upon completion.

Layered Credit Literacy

Implemented an expandable Card View system where complex credit factors were summarized first, allowing users to drill down for educational context only when they chose to.

Actionable Insights

The result screens moved beyond reporting data by focusing on clear, personalized recommendations for next steps, enhancing the tool value as a true financial guide.

Impact

Increased Consumer Trust

The clear, guided flow and visual presentation of sensitive data fostered immediate trust, leading to higher rates of data submission and journey completion.

Improved Financial Literacy

The Progressive Disclosure model successfully delivered complex educational content in a palatable format, empowering consumers to understand and improve their scores.

High Value Utility Positioning

The tool was established as a continuous financial guidance utility, increasing repeat engagement with the Aditya Birla Capital brand.
